previous_failure.assertion: The component with TestTag = 'r14.report.actions' is not displayed

root_cause: The first CR-0519 layout used a screen-derived max height but only constrained the bottom sheet with heightIn. Under ModalBottomSheet parent constraints this could still leave the long form without a fixed viewport, so the fixed action row was not displayed on device.

remediation.r14_report_sheet: Add explicit height(sheetMaxHeight) after heightIn(max = sheetMaxHeight), keep navigationBarsPadding, imePadding and HhySpacing.Xxl bottom buffer, and make the content body fill its weighted viewport.
remediation.r13_invalid_feedback_sheet: Apply the same explicit fixed sheet height and weighted scroll body to preserve historical-through-R14 visual closure.
